FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 308
Committee: Banking and Insurance Sponsor: Senator Josh Carnley
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 02/20/2026
Senate Bill 308 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Department of Insurance,
paid from the Insurance Department Fund, to establish the Office of Risk and Resilience,
created pursuant to the provisions of this bill, by an undetermined amount dependent upon the
compensations of one exempt service employee, to be set by the Commission of Insurance and
number of additional employees (and corresponding salaries) needed to operate the office.
